options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: Complete failure of the Chinese silk harvest
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: The opening of the Panama Canal
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

options.text: Outbreak of the American Civil War in 1861, cutting off American raw cotton supplies to Britain
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT concept for Cotton Boom.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Colonialism and Rural Society (Colonialism and Countryside) (Cotton Boom):
Outbreak of the American Civil War in 1861, cutting off American raw cotton supplies to Britain

Detailed Context:
1. When the American Civil War broke out in 1861, raw cotton imports to Britain from the USA collapsed, prompting British mills to look to the Bombay Deccan, triggering a massive cotton boom.
Hence Option D is correct.

Therefore, option (D) is the correct answer.

questionText: [Set 47.42] The Permanent Settlement introduced in Bengal by Governor-General Lord Cornwallis in 1793 established that:

options.text: Peasants were granted absolute freehold ownership rights over farmland
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
For Permanent Settlement of Bengal 1793 (Colonialism and Rural Society (Colonialism and Countryside)):
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 History (Colonialism and the Countryside - Permanent Settlement of Bengal 1793):

questionText:

Both Statement I and Statement II are correct

Hence, Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.

questionText:

(A) Permanent Settlement
(B) Ryotwari Settlement

(D) Mahalwari Settlement

List II:
(i) Bombay Deccan and Madras Presidency
(ii) Bengal, Bihar, and Orissa
(iii) North-Western Provinces and Punjab
(iv) Rajmahal foothills for Santhal settlement

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A-iii, B-i, C-ii, D-iv

options.text: A-ii, B-iv, C-iii, D-i

detailedSolution:

Hence Option B is correct.

Therefore, option (C) is the correct answer.
